requirements:
apache-airflow==2.7.1
httpx
flask
packaging
gevent
argcomplete
rich
flask-appbuilder
hatchling
diagrams
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-m", "airflow", "standalone"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes detected imports with apache-airflow as base dependency. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets airflow standalone as default command for development/testing.
